Hello, I am Lucifer. Would you like to make a deal with me?
Thou shall be rewarded, if thou bestow upon me the [color=yellow]Core of Ragna[/color]. This relic is the heart of the golem king, and only by felling him may one obtain it.
Unfortunate. Perhaps you shall reconsider… when you hold the Core.
Ah… I sense the [color=yellow]Core of Ragna[/color] upon thee. Dost thou offer it to me?
Excellent. With this, the path to the Gate of Ashes grows weaker… and closer.
Know this: thou hast traded not just a stone, but the fate of our realm.
A wise choice? Or a damning one? Time shall judge.
So be it. Guard it well, mortal. That Core is both a blessing and a curse.
Remember my words when the dawn breaks.
Lucifer vanishes in a cloud of smoke.
[shake]Who dares step in my chamber?[/shake] I am Golem Ragna, king of the underground. The weight of my fingers would crush you.
Impossible! How can a mere mortal withstand the pressure of the earth itself?!
The golem collapses into rubble, the ground shakes, and a glowing stone core remains.
Player obtains ‘[color=yellow]Core of Ragna[/color]’.
Inscriptions carved into stone:
‘Those who cast away their name shall find it here again. Those who open the gate shall never return.’
